dram_traffic.service_time_scope: service_ns sums per-task/owner completion spans, which may overlap; it is neither elapsed wall time nor data-bus busy time. resource_totals contains actual per-resource occupied time and bytes.

metadata.source_provenance: original JEDEC PDF obtained from a public third-party mirror; not a vendor interpretation
metadata.organization_selection: smallest covering raw capacity; equal capacity prefers 8H, 12H, 16H, 4H
metadata.channel_operation_mode_basis: JESD238 section 3.1.2 defines two pseudo-channels per channel; no alternative Legacy mode is defined for this generation
metadata.capacity_basis: binary DRAM address capacity; capacity_bytes is a separate visible budget
metadata.bandwidth_basis: caller aggregate directional Gb/s divided by 8; stack bandwidth is not multiplied again
metadata.data_rate_basis: equivalent per-pin rate derived from aggregate bandwidth and external data width, not measured pin speed
metadata.timing_basis: JEDEC command rules and stated minima; IDD example, legal MR reference selections and unknown vendor timings are separately labelled

source_documents.access_method: public mirror of original protocol PDF

geometry_limitations: linear mixed-radix simulation mapping is not a vendor address mapping
standard organization does not establish the target vendor part or timing
metadata.row_bytes_basis: JESD238 Table 4 note 3: row_bytes is the 1KiB effective addressed PC page; the MSB of RA selects half of an open 2KiB page
control_limitations: training, parity/ECC transport, auto-precharge and per-bank refresh are not implemented
address mapping, request scheduling, queue scope, open-page behavior and bandwidth-cap pacing are model policies, not JEDEC scheduling requirements
electrical PHY turnaround offsets and unspecified array timing gates require vendor inputs
metadata.accounting_basis: command bus occupancy, DQ busy time and dependency wait are separate; one full 32B DQ burst is charged once; WR recovery limits PRE and is not a write-completion tail
metadata.directional_cap_basis: independent read/write start pacing; DQ remains half-duplex at physical 2CK per burst; interleaved directions may together exceed either directional cap but never the physical interface

assumptions: B200 and Qwen are controlled substitutions, not the paper Rubin/Llama workload.

Paper-memory cases use generic page service with explicit research controls; not OCP/GC parity with scan cases.
throughput_scope: finite closed-batch decode window after first visible token; not continuous steady-state TPS
